General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Transmission Extension Case Oil Seal.
This is the Oil Seal that fits into the Extension Case where the Rear Drive Shaft connects.
If you are having a leak at the end of the transmission then you are needing this oil seal.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Oil Seal
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
